requests.ask: Add client/scripts/screen_meter.gd (no owner) to P2-S3-screenkit's files. It is the only caller that draws ScreenBox's code-drawn box, for the bars on six menu screens (settings, law, profile, social, codex, track). kit-spec.md 8.1 drops ScreenBox after S3's routing. With the file, ScreenMeter.bar becomes the kit's KitBar (bar_track + bar_fill tinted in its colour, drawn by RbBox through KitSkin, the code-drawn box where the switch is off), and screen_meter.gd's and screen_box.gd's draw records fall. The ring and the API stay as they are.
